newsitem.title: GREECE: CHICAGO STOCK EXCHANGE PRES MEETS BROKERS IN ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: CHICAGO STOCK EXCHANGE PRES MEETS BROKERS IN ATHENS.

text.p: Chicago stock exchange president Robert Forney briefed Greek brokers and institutional investors on the second largest U.S. bourse, the Association of Athens Stock Exchange Members (SMEHA), which organised the event, said on Wednesday.

The Chicago stock exchange which started trading in shares and bonds in May 1882 saw its trading volume surge to $124 billion in 1996. More than 4,000 issues are presently listed, a SMEHA statement said.
